# Medical News Today Connect

> > Healthcare provider directory and appointment booking platform by Medical News Today, connecting patients with doctors and medical specialists.

Medical News Today Connect serves as the patient-facing platform for finding healthcare providers, searching medical specialties, locating hospitals, and booking appointments online. This service extends Medical News Today's mission of health information accessibility into direct patient-provider connections.

## Key Topics

- Doctor search and discovery
- Appointment booking
- Healthcare provider directory
- Medical specialties
- Hospital finder
- Provider search
- Patient-provider matching
- Online healthcare scheduling
- Medical professional listings
- Healthcare accessibility

## Core Platform

- [Find a Doctor Near Me - Book Online - Medical News Today](http://connect.medicalnewstoday.com/): Main homepage for searching healthcare providers, browsing medical specialties, and booking appointments online through Medical News Today's directory platform
